headline: More than 1,000 Afghan refugees have been stuck at a camp in Qatar since 2021
context: More than 1,000 Afghan refugees who fled their homes in 2021 have been stuck in Camp As-Sayliyah, Qatar. They're isolated and unable to leave, despite many having aided U.S. forces during the war.
